name: SJTU PCI robot
full_name: SJTU master-slave PCI robot with magnetic-coupling modular drive and thin-film force sensing
group: Shanghai Jiao Tong University, School of Mechanical Engineering (Meng, Fang, Jing, Fu et al.)
target_anatomy: coronary PCI (complex vascular geometries in simulation and bench)
devices_driven: guidewire (0.014-0.035 in), guide catheter, balloon/stent catheter
n_dof_detail: 4 (guidewire advance and rotation; catheter linear insertion; balloon/stent linear transport)
translation_detail: friction-roller (guidewire: gear-driven dual friction wheels; balloon/stent: symmetric friction wheels; catheter: gear-rack clamping with linear drive)
rotation_detail: Guidewire rotated continuously through drive wheel 1 and bevel gears (360 deg)
force_sensing: Thin-film pressure sensors between worm and housing give axial guidewire force
sterility: Electromechanical decoupling by magnetic coupling torque transmission so the distal module can be a hygienic, separable part
validation_detail: Simulink control simulation plus hardware experiments; number of trials N.R.
key_numbers: Displacement error within +/-1 mm and angular error within +/-15 deg; Smith predictor + RBF self-tuning PID
